title: Gold
subtitle: A containerized environment for working on provably correct software

sections.mission: Make rigorous software development environments reproducible and accessible from a browser or terminal.
sections.challenge: Formal methods and scientific software stacks are difficult to install, secure, reproduce and share across machines.
approach: Package browser-based development, notebooks and formal-method tools in versioned containers.
Automate image construction, health checks and multi-architecture release workflows.
impact: Reduce setup time for reproducible software and formal-method experiments.
Provide a portable environment for teaching, analysis and verified software development.

research.focus: Reproducible environments for formal methods and sustainable scientific software
